content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I am unable to find a download for [product_name] V2.0 anywhere. I have [product_name] on disk dated 24.10.2017—does this correspond to V2.0? If someone has it, please share a link. Also, can the counter value from the up/down counter be output in [product_name]?

The download for [product_name] V2.0 is no longer available. However, you can get the current version V2.1.1 by following the instructions for the upgrade of [product_name] V8.4. And yes, it's possible to link the up/down counter value to [product_name].
Hi [user_name], you can obtain the tool using the following link: Instructions for [product_name] upgrade V8.4.
Why are you sharing the same link that I already posted earlier?
Thank you very much, kind person!

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter problems accessing older software versions such as [product_name] V2.0, which leads to confusion about product versioning and available software. There is also ambiguity about whether some features, like exporting counter values, are supported by the tool. The main issues involve restricted access to discontinued software and unclear information about product capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to access previous software versions and want clearer documentation covering version-specific features and compatibility. They also desire a straightforward way to export counter data in [product_name].
